版本号越新排得越上面；每条都是玩家能直接看到的变化。: Newer versions are listed first; every entry is a change you can see in game.
带粗体的是这一版最值得看的几件事。: Bold entries are the highlights of that version.
敌方名单重做：现在一共有 193 只宝可梦可以遇到，**每一只在整个游戏里只出现: Foe lineups rebuilt: 193 Pokémon can now show up, and **each one appears on only one map in the whole game**.
每一张地图的杂兵与精英都补到了 12 只以上，一局之内不会再撞见同一只 —— 同: Every map now has 12 or more regular foes and elites, and you won't run into the same one twice in a run — no repeats even after a dozen battles on the same map.
夜砂墓原换成了清一色的幽灵与墓场宝可梦；雷暴台地上不再有鱼；每张图的名单都按各自: Night Sand Barrens is now all Ghost-type and graveyard Pokémon; the Thunder Plateau no longer has any Water-type Pokémon; every map's lineup was picked again to fit its theme.
世代摊开了：第八、第九世代的宝可梦第一次出现在这份名单里，第一世代不再是主力。: The generations are spread out now: Gen 8 and Gen 9 Pokémon appear on this list for the first time, and Gen 1 is no longer the main lineup.
修好了赤面龙、电龙这些新宝可梦的行走图（帧尺寸算错了，画面上会并排出现两只）。: Fixed the walking sprites for new Pokémon like Druddigon and Ampharos (the frame size was wrong, so two of them showed up side by side).
修好了几个名字：「电飞鼠」「迭失棺」，还有「沙铃仙人掌」的日文写法。: Fixed a few names: "Emolga", "Cofagrigus", and the Japanese spelling of "Maractus".
标题页新增三个入口：**通关记录**（每局走到第几章、多少步、走过哪几张图，还能: Three new entries on the title screen: **Run Records** (which chapter and how many steps each run reached, which maps you crossed, plus that run's deck), **Card Codex**, and **Pokémon Codex**.
敌人图鉴按地图分节：没遇见过的只显示剪影与图鉴编号，遇见过的能看到它的台词、招牌: The Pokémon Codex is split into sections by map: ones you haven't met show only a silhouette and a dex number, while ones you have met show their lines, signature move, and move pool.
游戏内也能开敌人图鉴：地图页的按钮、战斗里右上角的靶心，或者直接按 E（卡牌图鉴: You can also open the Pokémon Codex in game: the button on the map screen, the target icon in the top right of a battle, or just press E (press C for the Card Codex).
精英与首领的奖励一定给卡；稀有度也按档位给，越难的对手给得越好。: Elite and boss rewards always include a card, and rarity follows the tier — the harder the foe, the better the card.
中间四章的地图改成随机：遗迹、菌菇湿地、雷暴台地、水晶洞窟会和原来的地图轮着来。: The maps in the middle four chapters are now random: Sunken Ruins, Fungal Marsh, Thunder Plateau, and Crystal Cavern rotate with the original maps.
新增四张地图各自的头领，以及配套的流派卡：出血、虚弱、削弱，还有新机制「恶化」「: Added a boss for each of the four new maps, along with matching build cards: Bleed, Weakened, and Weaken, plus the new Worsen and Transference mechanics.
一局里的六张地图不重样，走到哪一章都可能撞见新面孔。: The six maps in a run are all different, so new faces can turn up in any chapter.
加入日本語与 English：界面、卡牌、事件、宝可梦名字都跟着语言走，标题页与: Added Japanese and English: the UI, cards, events, and Pokémon names all follow the selected language, and you can switch on the title screen or in settings.
日文照宝可梦原版的写法：招式名、道具名、属性名、物种名不写汉字，状态名全平假名。: Japanese follows the official Pokémon style: move names, item names, type names, and species names are written without kanji, and status names are all in hiragana.
卡面加宽，日文与英文的长名字、长描述不再被切掉。: Cards are wider, so long Japanese and English names and descriptions are no longer cut off.
战斗奖励的稀有度按对手档位给：精英与首领的卡明显比路边的更好。: Battle reward rarity now follows the foe's tier: elite and boss cards are clearly better than the ones you pick up on the road.
卡组一览可以排序，点开单卡能看到效果明细与关键词解释。: The deck list can be sorted, and clicking a single card shows its effect details and keyword explanations.
说明页里的数字全部改成实时读取，不会再过期。: The numbers on the help pages are now read live, so they can't go stale.
第一版：六章、一百九十多张卡、一百五十多只宝可梦，分叉地图加卡牌战斗。: First release: six chapters, over 190 cards, more than 150 Pokémon, branching maps, and card battles.
主角是雌性沙漠蜻蜓**欧亚西莉亚**；走到夜砂墓原的尽头就算通关。: The protagonist is a female Flygon named **Oasilia**; reach the end of the Night Sand Barrens to clear the game.
